title: VAT note — Blue Harbor LLC (sample)
text: Blue Harbor LLC is a fictional wholesale trader. The standard VAT scheme applies: output VAT on taxable supplies at the standard rate, input VAT reclaim on qualifying costs. Exempt supplies (listed financial fees) do not carry output VAT. The entity is not on a flat-rate scheme. Quarterly VAT returns are due one month after each quarter end. Keep sales invoices and purchase ledgers for six years.

title: Engagement letter — year-end (sample)
text: This sample engagement letter covers corporate return preparation for fictional client North Pine Trading. Key deadlines in the engagement letter: client delivers the draft trial balance by 15 October; accountant delivers the review pack by 5 November; corporate filing deadline is 30 November. Out-of-scope items: transfer-pricing studies and litigation support. Fees are fixed for the listed schedules; extra work is quoted first.

title: Corporate return pack — required attachments
text: Required attachments for the sample corporate return pack: (1) signed trial balance, (2) general ledger export for the year, (3) fixed-asset register, (4) payroll summary including W-2 equivalents, (5) bank reconciliations for all accounts, (6) related-party transaction schedule, (7) prior-year return PDF. Optional: inventory count sheets if stock exceeds the materiality threshold in the engagement letter.

title: Review memo — risk flags (sample)
text: Sample review memo risk flags: (A) related-party rent lacks written agreement — request contract. (B) Large year-end accrual for bonuses without board minute — obtain approval evidence. (C) Cut-off testing on the last five sales invoices shows one post-period shipment — adjust revenue. (D) Obsolete inventory reserve looks light versus ageing — challenge with warehouse. No going-concern flag in this sample.

title: Year-end close checklist (sample)
text: Year-end close checklist: reconcile all bank and credit-card accounts; post accruals and prepayments; roll fixed assets and depreciation; count and value inventory; confirm related-party balances; review cut-off for sales and purchases; update deferred tax workings; prepare draft statements; run analytical review; partner sign-off before filing. Tick each item with initials and date.
